vague: Some users report that integer range options with clamping return values outside the allowed range. Please fix it.
specific: Bug: IntRange._clamp in src/click/types.py moves in the wrong direction for open bounds. click.IntRange(0, min_open=True, clamp=True).convert('0', None, None) returns -1 but should return 1. Fix it, add regression cases to the clamp parametrize list at the top of tests/test_types.py, and verify with: python -m pytest tests/test_types.py -q

specific: Bug: in --help output an option declared as @click.option('--verbose', '-v') is rendered as '--verbose, -v' but should be '-v, --verbose' (shorter prefixes first). The ordering happens in join_options in src/click/formatting.py. Fix it and verify with: python -m pytest tests/test_formatting.py tests/test_options.py -q

vague: Shell completion gives wrong results when an argument contains a # character. Please fix it.
specific: Bug: split_arg_string in src/click/shell_completion.py treats '#' as the start of a comment, so split_arg_string('cmd a#b') returns ['cmd', 'a'] instead of ['cmd', 'a#b']. Fix the shlex lexer configuration there, add a test to tests/test_shell_completion.py, and verify with: python -m pytest tests/test_shell_completion.py -q

vague: Defaults configured through default_map are ignored for subcommands. Please fix it.
specific: Bug: per-subcommand defaults in default_map are ignored. With @click.group() cli and a subcommand foo having @click.option('--name', default='normal'), invoking cli with default_map={'foo': {'name': 'changed'}} prints 'normal' instead of 'changed'. A child Context should take its section of the parent's default_map, keyed by info_name, in Context.__init__ in src/click/core.py. Fix it, add a regression test to tests/test_commands.py, and verify with: python -m pytest tests/test_commands.py tests/test_defaults.py -q
